message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Only the phase_bits=16 linear LUT meets the 8-LSB quality target, but it is the largest LUT area. Since increase_precision and change_interpolation have no legal unvisited neighbors, decreasing precision is the available move that may reduce mapped area while staying near the only passing configuration; the CORDIC alternatives are larger and still fail quality."}
